Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of lower back pain and stiffness. The
reported severity of the injury is notable given how light the impact appeared, and this mismatch was cnosidered at
intake. Over the course of 28 visits, care followed a conventional path of manual therapy, guided exercise, and a
home stretching program. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was gradually reduced as function
returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly support a lumbar strain. The patient reports no prior
injury to the lumbar region, and no earlier treatment for this area is known to our records. Two billing entries for similar
services recorded on the same day are currently under review by our office and will be reconciled separately. The
patient was discharged to self-management with return precautions.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
